purpose: Pre-register a navigation/transport-only amendment after v1.0 achieved CONDITIONAL_ROUTE but not FULL_ROUTE_TECHNICALLY_VIABLE on the frozen 40-case probe.

allowed: ticker/P856 navigation disambiguation when Wikidata returns multiple candidate entities
first-party sitemap recursion and sitemap-index parsing
first-party homepage and investor-relations one-hop link expansion
official subdomain probes under an already accepted official P856 root
deterministic path-template expansion on accepted official domains
forbidden: using realized returns or ARGOS PnL
using SEC, news, aggregators, search snippets, or third-party pages as truth voters
executing the 1,355-event earnings route before a v1.1 capacity result is frozen

sample_binding.rerun_scope: same frozen 40 cases, not failure-only and not full 1355 queue

issuer_resolution_v1_1.base_source: Wikidata Query Service P249 ticker symbol and P856 official website
issuer_resolution_v1_1.new_disambiguation_rule: If P249/P856 returns multiple candidate entities for a ticker, accept a unique entity only when exactly one candidate's English label, alias text, or normalized P856 host is compatible with issuer identity tokens derived from the frozen pretruth_subject_key. If none or more than one candidate remains, fail closed as UNRESOLVED_NO_GUESS.
issuer_resolution_v1_1.zero_entity_rule: If no P249/P856 entity exists, do not guess an issuer. The case remains UNRESOLVED_NO_GUESS unless already covered by an explicitly frozen input-repair manifest created before external requests.

allowed_roots: accepted P856 host after stripping leading www
subdomains of the accepted normalized P856 host
additional_first_party_entrypoints: robots.txt sitemap URLs with sitemap-index recursion depth 2
sitemap.xml and sitemap_index.xml on accepted official host
homepage canonical/alternate links and first-party hrefs containing investor, ir, financial, results, newsroom, news, press, events, presentations, quarterly, earnings
one-hop crawl from first-party investor-relations landing pages only
official subdomain roots: investors.<host>, investor.<host>, ir.<host>, newsroom.<host>

http_transport_hardening.retry_policy: up to 3 GET attempts with deterministic backoff for 0, 429, and 5xx statuses

candidate_acceptance_v1_1.identity_basis: issuer core identity tokens from frozen pretruth_subject_key must bind to an official-domain body; earnings numeric values are not parsed, compared, or persisted

next_allowed_action: Freeze an implementation executor bound to this protocol, then run exactly one v1.1 40-case capacity probe before considering any wider earnings execution.
